title: 蘑菇要塞 Mushroom Garrison
description: Plant blooming mushroom turrets along forest trails and defend the seed vault in a hand-painted tower defense. 在林间小路种下会开花的蘑菇炮塔，守护种子仓库。

defaultCaptions.x: Blooming mushroom turrets vs. a swarm of forest pests. Can you 3-star all three maps in Mushroom Garrison?
defaultCaptions.facebook: Mushroom Garrison: a cozy hand-painted tower defense. Plant, upgrade and branch four blooming mushroom turrets to protect the seed vault.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Mushroom Garrison — a hand-painted 2D tower defense with four branching mushroom turrets, three maps and a mouse, keyboard, gamepad and touch friendly UI.
defaultCaptions.discord: Try Mushroom Garrison / 蘑菇要塞 — defend the seed vault with blooming mushroom turrets!
